name: Audio visualizer
what: Bars around a round picture, a row of bars, or a glowing wave jumping on every beat of the tempo you set - each bar its own height, a bigger hit on the downbeat, a small one between beats - and falling back; the picture pulses on the downbeats. For music and podcasts.
origin: audio visualizers - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16; it follows a tempo, not the sound itself
motion: on each beat (bpm, from offset) every bar jumps in 2 f (slow end) and falls over the beat; downbeat 100 %, beats 80 %, 8ths 45 %; the picture pulses 6 % on downbeats
